item.title: Whiskers 0.8.32
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.32

### New: Rolling Free-Tier Usage Windows

  • Free dictation limits now reset on a rolling basis ( wtmp begins Mon Feb 23 04:41:00 UTC 2026 and wtmp begins Mon Feb 23 04:41:00 UTC 2026) instead of waiting for calendar day/week boundaries, so usage restores progressively based on elapsed time.
  • Bulk transcription free-tier use now follows a rolling 24-hour window.

    • ### Improvements

  • Updated settings copy and usage labels to match the new rolling behavior:

    ### Bug Fixes

  • Fixed license activation for valid keys that were previously rejected before machine setup due to stricter fingerprint payload behavior.
  • Improved recovery when activation APIs return “already activated / already exists” style responses by reusing the existing matching machine instead of failing the license flow.
